brand_identity.name: Circle Concept Higher Secondary School
brand_identity.mission: Forging the next generation of scientists and engineers through disciplined excellence.

design_philosophy.theme: Light Mode Primary with Deep Navy Authority
design_philosophy.core_concept: The Golden Ratio of Education - where structure meets brilliance.
design_philosophy.visual_style: Modern Swiss Academic. High contrast, sharp typography, generous whitespace, disciplined grids.
anti_patterns: No generic 'school blue' - use deep Navy only.
No comic sans or playful fonts.
No cluttered layouts - every element must breathe.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. Global CSS: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css immediately.
3. Theme: Ensure 'bg-white' is the default body background, text is 'slate-900'.
4. Hero Section: Use the 'hero_main' image with a heavy linear-gradient overlay (from 'blue-950/90' to 'blue-900/40') to ensure text readability.
5. Navbar: Implement a sticky navbar that changes style on scroll (transparent at top, solid/glass on scroll).
6. Bento Grid: Use for the 'Why Choose Us' or 'Features' section. Mix large and small cards.
7. Forms: Use standard HTML/React forms but styled to match the 'Input' component from Shadcn (clean borders, focus rings).
8. Footer: Must be Deep Navy ('bg-blue-950') with White text and Gold accents.
9. Accessibility: Ensure all text on images has a sufficient background overlay.
10. Performance: Use lazy loading for images below the fold.
